title: Minimum Area Rectangle II
description: Find the minimum area of a rectangle formed by 4 points from a given set of points.

steps.note: Initialize empty hash map to store pairs of points by their center and diagonal length.
Calculate center of points [0,0] and [1,1]. Center: [0.5, 0.5], DistSq: 2.
Check map for existing diagonal with same center [0.5, 0.5] and length 2. Found pair [1,0] and [0,1].
Calculate area of rectangle formed by these 4 points: 1 * 1 = 1.0.
